territory: Every off-repo (real-world) asset the Union controls, reachable from /home/emsenn/info: credential-pointed crypto wallets and exchange/brokerage accounts, the Hive account fleet (folded in from today's own hive-idle-capital-assessment record), the Alpaca paper account, the cold-red-gate VPS, Cloudflare/GitHub/Deno compute accounts, five YouTube channels, and four domains.
mandate: READ-ONLY throughout. No transfers, no signing, no order placement. No seed phrase was ever transmitted off this machine; all mnemonic handling was local, offline, and checked against a public wordlist only.

method.credentialEnumeration: grep of key names only (never values) from .env and .union-evm.env; per-key shape classification (word count / hex-length / charset) computed locally and printed only as counts, never as content.
cryptoBalanceChecks: eth_getBalance / eth_call(balanceOf) / eth_getTransactionCount against https://mainnet.base.org for the known earning address
same against https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc (Arbitrum) and https://ethereum.publicnode.com (Ethereum mainnet) for the same address
local, offline BIP39 mnemonic validation (@scure/bip39 English wordlist + ethers HDNodeWallet.fromPhrase) against every seed-phrase-shaped .env value -- never transmitted, never used to sign
method.coinbaseCdp: live read-only calls via @coinbase/cdp-sdk (evm.listAccounts, evm.listSmartAccounts, solana.listAccounts, policies.listPolicies, endUser.listEndUsers, listFoundationAccounts, listPaymentMethods) using COINBASE_EPHEMERIS_API_KEY_ID/_SECRET from .env
method.hive: folded in verbatim from lib/emsenn/services/board-of-directors/services/executive-office/services/leader-movement-team/data/records/hive-capital-assays/2026/07/23/2026-07-23-union-hive-idle-capital-assessment.json, produced the same day via api.hive.blog read-only calls
method.alpacaAndVps: live read-only calls confirmed via the repo's own capability-registry.json (2026-07-23 audit) plus a fresh SSH BatchMode reachability check against cold-red-gate
method.accountsAndDomains: live HTTP checks (curl) against each domain/status endpoint; live token-verify calls against GitHub and Cloudflare APIs; a live Deno Deploy API call to check token validity
